main_text.p: citur in Ithpehal אסתכי per Samech. Ad a est Imaginari, Cogitare.
שכירת f. Imago, Effigies, Figura, Pi[ctura?] שכיות החמדה Imagines desiderii, hoc est Iesa.2.16.

שכוי masc. Intellectus, Mens, quasi In[telligentia?] guratrix dicta, quòd omnia Providet c[...] נתן לשכוי בינה Quis dedit menti intelligentiam? v.36. Chaldaeus ללבא Cordi, Animo, Vulgatus Latinus interpres, Quis dedit g[...] tiam? Ea interpretatio ex prisc is Hebraeis quos legitur: R. Schimeon filius Lak[isch?] peregrinarer in Aphrica, audivi quòd appellarent נִנְפִי Nimpham, & רנגול linaceum, שכוי. Unde hoc? inde q[uod?] bum dicitur: Quis indidit בטחות p[...] pientiam? Quis dedit לשכוי (id est, gallinaceo) intelligentiam? Cod. R. cap.3. fol.26. Simile quid de Gallo obser[vatur]. Vide illic. Horum meminerunt R.Salomo, id est, R. Mosche ben Nachman. Hinc e[st] precibus matutinis quotidie precantur: Dominus Deus nofter, rex hujus mu[ndi], לשכוי בינה qui dedit gallo gallinac[eo] intelligentiam: nempe; Quia cantu suo est praeco d[iei] ad operas excitat, ideo non tantùm mane[?] xerunt, sed etiam ad gallicinia, hanc preci[em] bent. Praeterea in Bereschit rabba, sectio בערביא צווחין לתרנגולא סכויא In Arab[ico?] lum סכויא.
משכיית f. Imago, Imaginatio, Cogit[atio]. Effigies: ואבן משכיית Et lapidem effigiei

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off most lines, so every line that ends in "[...]" or in a short fragment is cut short by the scan, not by the printer. Several Hebrew words are doubtful and are not marked with [?] because the scan is too small to confirm the letters: שכירת, אסתכי, נִנְפִי, רנגול, בטחות, סכויא. The Hebrew running head reads שכו. The headword of the first entry is partly visible and may not match the printed form. Latin transliteration "Jefa" was read as Iesa. The page has no catchword and no marginal notes.
